name: hub-config-roster
description: The /config modal lists the Hub Roster dropdown (the folder's roster, default gems); picking another and saving to Local lands plugins.hub.roster in the folder's .kollab/config.json. Plain kollab (--no-daemon) in a throwaway HOME, no keyring, no model call.

config.command: sh -c 'R=$(pwd); H=$(cat "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-config-roster.path"); cd "$H/ws" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 exec "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon'

steps.description: throwaway HOME: a profile that is never called
steps.command: P="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-config-roster.path"; H=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-config-roster.XXXXXX"); printf %s "$H" > "$P"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab" "$H/ws"; touch "$H/.kollab/connect-guide-seen"; printf '{"application":{"setup_completed":true},"kollabor":{"llm":{"active_profile":"fake","profiles":{"fake":{"provider":"custom","model":"fake-echo","base_url":"http://127.0.0.1:9/v1","api_key":"not-a-real-key"}}}}}' > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; echo "throwaway home ready"

steps.label: the modal lists the Roster dropdown
a Local save lands in the folder's .kollab/config.json

steps.description: the folder's own config holds the choice
